scenario: After a long-term imprisonment and while awaiting a parole decision, a convicted murderer wants to organise a foundation for young victims of crime. I am the president of the agency who decides about the foundation. The founder would donate 65,000 dollars to the foundation. However, he asks that the foundation would be named after himself, helping clear his name. The family of his victim opposes such a foundation and considers it highly upsetting. If I accept the donation that requires the foundation to be named after the murderer, crime victims will benefit from the 65,000 dollars. If I do not do this, the money will be lost.
choice: I decide to accept the donation that requires the foundation to be named after the murderer
